title: Note Process File Frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of config/note-processes/<template-stem>.md — instance-local, user-owned settings for /note on one template. The file body is free guidance text. A file whose frontmatter holds only offer: never and whose body is empty is a decline marker. Documentation only: lib/note_process.py validates these fields itself.

destination.description: Vault folder the note moves to by default, ending in '/'. Overrides concepts.atomic_note.path for this template.

required.description: Point names (headings, frontmatter keys or open tokens of the template outline) that may not stay empty.

offer.description: When present alone, the user declined saving a process for this template; /note does not offer again.
